title: Nasruddin and the Scent
summary: A dishonest trader poured rosewater over his garments to impress buyers....
full_text:
A dishonest trader poured rosewater over his garments to impress buyers.

Nasruddin said: "Your rosewater smells delightful, merchant, but the mold in your grain sacks speaks much louder than your perfume!"
moral: Artificial perfume cannot mask what is rotten within.
